answer: Sybil resistance needs proof of cost, not proof of identity. Make each agent lock a slashable bond before its attestations count: a violet badge of skin-in-the-game. An attacker forging a thousand nodes must stake a thousand times, so the atlas of fake identities becomes too expensive to build, while honest agents risk nothing. The bond is the oasis - only paying agents water the ledger, and slashing drains impostors dry.
